Portanto, a alternativa correta é a C (R$ 44,55).

Questão sobre adolescente que toma leite viralizou nas redes — Foto: Reprodução/Redes sociais

A lógica é a mesma para outras unidades do sistema internacional de medidas. Os prefixos indicam quantas vezes uma medida é maior ou menor do que a unidade de referência, que pode ser litro (volume/capacidade), metro (comprimento) ou grama (massa).

Se você souber esta tabela aqui abaixo, conseguirá responder qualquer questão de conversão. Sempre que avançar uma “casinha” para a direita, multiplicará por 10. Quando voltar uma “casinha” para a esquerda, dividirá por 10.

Em metros: quilômetro, hectômetro, decâmetro, METRO, decímetro, centímetro, milímetro.

Em litros (só trocar m ou l): quilolitro, hectolitro, decalitro, LITRO, decilitro, centilitro, mililitro.

Em gramas: quilograma, hectograma, decagrama, GRAMA, decigrama, centigrama, miligrama.

Vamos testar com uma unidade mais usada: quilograma. Nós sabemos que 1 kg são 1.000 gramas, certo? Teste na tabela.

Avançamos três casinhas para a direita, ou seja, multiplicamos por mil. 1 kg = 1.000 gramas.

E com o decilitro? Mesmo raciocínio: Do dl para o l, temos de andar uma casinha para a esquerda, ou seja, dividir por 10.

articles.title: Tenho mais de uma dívida: qual negociar primeiro? | G1
articles.standfirst: Contas atrasadas, cartão de crédito e empréstimos podem se acumular. Veja como organizar as pendências e escolher por onde começar a renegociação.
articles.summary: Contas atrasadas, cartão de crédito e empréstimos podem se acumular. Veja como organizar as pendências e escolher por onde começar a renegociação.
articles.body:
Plataforma da Acordo Certo orienta sobre ordem de pagamento para evitar corte de serviços e juros abusivos — Foto: Acordo Certo/Divulgação

Quando várias contas ficam atrasadas ao mesmo tempo , surge uma dúvida comum: qual dívida pagar primeiro? O cartão de crédito, o empréstimo, a conta de luz ou aquela cobrança antiga que continua aparecendo?

A vontade de resolver tudo de uma vez é compreensível, mas nem sempre existe dinheiro suficiente para isso. E tentar assumir vários acordos ao mesmo tempo pode criar novos problemas, principalmente quando as parcelas começam a vencer.

Nessa situação, o melhor caminho é organizar as pendências e estabelecer prioridades . Algumas dívidas exigem atenção imediata, enquanto outras podem ser negociadas conforme as condições disponíveis e a capacidade de pagamento.

Primeiro, descubra todas as dívidas que estão em aberto

Antes de escolher qual dívida negociar, é importante conhecer o tamanho do problema. Assim sendo, é importante identificar os valores pendentes, as empresas responsáveis pelas cobranças e há quanto tempo cada conta está atrasada.

Comece reunindo boletos, faturas, notificações de cobrança e informações disponíveis nos aplicativos dos bancos e das empresas com as quais você mantém contratos.

Outra possibilidade é consultar gratuitamente seu CPF na Acordo Certo , que permite verificar as dívidas disponibilizadas pelas empresas parceiras e conhecer as ofertas de renegociação existentes.

Com essas informações, organize uma relação simples contendo o nome do credor, o valor devido, a situação do pagamento e as condições oferecidas para quitar ou parcelar cada débito.

Vale lembrar que nem todas as dívidas aparecem necessariamente em uma única plataforma . Por isso, confira também os canais oficiais das empresas com as quais você possui compromissos.

Esse levantamento ajuda a evitar esquecimentos e permite enxergar quais cobranças merecem atenção primeiro.

Nem toda dívida atrasada provoca as mesmas consequências. Por isso, a ordem de pagamento deve considerar o impacto de cada pendência na sua rotina e no orçamento familiar .

Contas essenciais: água, energia elétrica e outras despesas indispensáveis merecem atenção especial. A falta de pagamento pode comprometer serviços necessários para o funcionamento da casa, observadas as regras aplicáveis a cada serviço.

Dívidas com juros elevados: cartão de crédito e cheque especial também exigem cuidado. Os encargos podem aumentar o valor devido ao longo do tempo, tornando a regularização mais difícil.

Empréstimos e financiamentos: verifique as condições do contrato, principalmente quando existe algum bem associado à operação, como um veículo ou imóvel.

Dívidas antigas: também podem apresentar oportunidades de negociação. Antes de aceitar uma proposta, confirme a origem da cobrança, o valor solicitado e as condições do acordo.

Ainda que essa ordem seja uma boa base prioritária, se uma dívida oferece risco imediato à manutenção de um serviço essencial ou de um bem importante, por exemplo, ela pode exigir uma providência mais urgente.

Por isso, o mais importante é avaliar as consequências de cada atraso, em vez de escolher apenas a cobrança de menor valor .

Vale a pena negociar várias dívidas ao mesmo tempo?

Dependendo do quanto de dinheiro você tem disponível mensalmente, vale a pena negociar várias dívidas ao mesmo tempo. No entanto, certifique-se de que a soma das prestações não ultrapasse sua capacidade de pagamento.

Por exemplo, se você tem disponível R$ 500 para pagar dívidas, e consegue 3 acordos de R$ 150, essa pode ser uma decisão inteligente. Agora se os valores ultrapassam ou ficam no limite do quanto você pode disponibilizar, é preciso ligar o sinal de alerta.

Também é importante observar as datas de vencimento . Ter várias parcelas concentradas no mesmo período pode dificultar a organização financeira, mesmo quando os valores são relativamente baixos.

Como saber quantas dívidas cabem no orçamento?

Depois de estabelecer prioridades, o próximo passo é descobrir quanto você consegue destinar aos acordos sem comprometer as despesas essenciais .

Para isso, a Acordo Certo oferece gratuitamente a calculadora Dívidas no orçamento . Na ferramenta, basta informar sua renda mensal líquida e o valor total que pretende pagar em dívidas todos os meses.

O resultado mostra qual percentual da renda ficará comprometido com esses pagamentos e quanto dinheiro sobrará para as demais despesas.

Você pode começar somando as parcelas de todos os acordos que pretende fechar. Se o valor restante não for suficiente para os gastos necessários, retire uma das parcelas da simulação e veja como o orçamento fica.

Dessa maneira, é possível comparar diferentes combinações de acordos e identificar quais compromissos podem ser assumidos naquele momento.

Com a relação de pendências organizada e as prioridades definidas, procure as empresas responsáveis pelas cobranças e verifique as propostas disponíveis.

Na Acordo Certo , você pode consultar gratuitamente as ofertas de negociação vinculadas ao seu CPF e disponibilizadas pelas empresas parceiras, pelo site ou aplicativo.

Não é necessário resolver todas as pendências de uma só vez. Começar pelas dívidas mais urgentes e assumir apenas parcelas que você consegue pagar é uma forma de avançar na organização financeira sem criar novos atrasos.

A Acordo Certo é uma plataforma de renegociação de dívidas do grupo Consumidor Positivo, que tem como foco o bem-estar financeiro dos brasileiros. Pelo site e pelo aplicativo, qualquer pessoa consulta gratuitamente as dívidas ligadas ao seu CPF, compara ofertas de empresas parceiras e fecha acordos com segurança, sem sair de casa. A Acordo Certo também oferece conteúdos de educação financeira e ferramentas gratuitas, como a calculadora Dívidas no orçamento, para ajudar cada pessoa a organizar as contas e tomar decisões com mais tranquilidade.

Para quem mora em Rio Preto e região: de 26 a 28 de novembro de 2026, a Carreta Acordo Certo estará na Praça Dom José Marcondes , com atendimento presencial e gratuito para consultar o CPF e renegociar dívidas. Quem preferir também pode negociar a qualquer momento pelo site ou pelo aplicativo da Acordo Certo.

articles.title: Defesa Civil de MG: falha envia alerta de Montes Claros para BH | G1
articles.standfirst: Segundo o órgão, houve uma falha pontual e episódio não compromete a importância e a eficácia do serviço.
articles.summary: Defesa Civil de MG esclarece que alerta de tempestade enviado a Belo Horizonte era para Montes Claros e ocorreu por uma falha pontual no sistema de emergência.
articles.body:
A Defesa Civil de Minas Gerais informou que o alerta severo para tempestade com chuva moderada a forte recebido por volta das 09h57 desta manhã de segunda-feira (16) em Belo Horizonte , na verdade, era direcionado exclusivamente ao município de Montes Claros, no Norte do estado.

Segundo o órgão, houve uma falha pontual no sistema durante o disparo da mensagem.

Em nota, a Coordenadoria Estadual de Defesa Civil (Cedec) informou ao g1 que o episódio não compromete a importância e a eficácia do serviço.

"O sistema de alertas é uma ferramenta segura e confiável, que utiliza tecnologia moderna para informar antecipadamente a população sobre situações de risco, contribuindo para a prevenção de desastres e a proteção de vidas" afirmou.

Defesa Civil de Minas Gerais informa que belorizontinos receberam alerta de Montes Claros por falha pontual no sistema — Foto: Imagem cedida à TV Globo

No início desta tarde, chuva e ventos intensos foram registrados na capital mineira. Na ocasião, às 14h24 o alerta severo foi enviado sem intercorrências para os belorizontinos.

O 'Defesa Civil Alerta' é uma ferramenta de envio de notificações de emergência do governo federal, coordenada pela Defesa Civil Nacional e pela Agência Nacional de Telecomunicações Anatel, executada pelas prestadoras de telefonia móvel.

Segundo o governo, o sistema envia mensagens de texto e avisos sonoros para os celulares em áreas de muito risco, sem necessidade de cadastro prévio. Os alertas aparecem de forma destacada na tela e podem tocar mesmo nos aparelhos em modo silencioso.

Os alertas alcançam celulares compatíveis (Android e iOS lançados a partir de 2020) e com cobertura de telefonia móvel com tecnologia 4G ou 5G. Além disso, o recurso não depende de pacote de dados e funciona mesmo se o usuário estiver ou não conectado ao Wi-Fi

Como agem os dois tipos de alertas emitidos pela Defesa Civil:

🟠 Alerta severo: além do texto, emite um "beep" no smartphone, mas só toca se o aparelho não estiver no modo silencioso.

🔴 Alerta extremo: aciona um sinal sonoro semelhante a uma sirene, além da mensagem em texto. O som é ativado mesmo se o celular estiver no modo silencioso.

articles.title: Tempestade e chuva de granizo no CE: Inmet emite alerta para o estado | G1
articles.standfirst: O Ceará, conforme o Inmet, tem ainda baixo risco de corte de energia elétrica, estragos em plantações, queda de galhos de árvores e de alagamentos.
articles.summary: O Ceará, conforme o Inmet, tem ainda baixo risco de corte de energia elétrica, estragos em plantações, queda de galhos de árvores e de alagamentos.
articles.body:
O Ceará tem 45 municípios ( veja lista abaixo ) sob alerta do Instituto Nacional de Meteorologia ( Inmet ) de perigo potencial de tempestade. A informação foi repassada nesta segunda-feira (16).

O órgão informou que o estado tem cenário favorável à chuva entre 20 e 30 mm/h ou até 50 mm/dia, ventos intensos (40-60 km/h), e queda de granizo.

O Ceará, conforme o Inmet, tem ainda baixo risco de corte de energia elétrica, estragos em plantações, queda de galhos de árvores e de alagamentos.

Os municípios constavam na lista do Inmet até o início da tarde desta segunda-feira.

Tempestade e chuva de granizo no Ceará: Inmet emite alerta para municípios do estado. — Foto: Pexels

Há uma semana, o Crato registrou uma chuva intensa que deixou prejuízos em diversos pontos da cidade . A precipitação durou aproximadamente 15 minutos, de acordo com Humberto Júnior, coordenador da Defesa Civil da cidade. Já a ventania, que chegou a aproximadamente 100 km/h em alguns locais, durou 7 minutos.

"Sobre esse fenômeno que aconteceu, foi uma coisa rara. Foram 7 minutos de vento e 15 de chuva. A Praça Bicentenário foi o epicentro (do temporal). Graças a Deus nenhum ferido. Tivemos só uma casa que foi danificada pela queda de uma árvore, mas (os moradores) foram realocados com aluguel social", explicou o coordenador Humberto à TV Verdes Mares.

Um levantamento da Defesa Civil apontou que aproximadamente 200 árvores foram danificadas, tombadas ou arrancadas pela raiz em diferentes pontos da cidade. Além disso, bairros ficaram sem energia elétrica e água, o teto de um ginásio desabou, semáforos foram desligados, aulas foram suspensas, entre outras consequências.

articles.title: Olhos ardendo e cansados na menopausa? Entenda a relação com o olho seco e por que isso merece atenção | G1
articles.standfirst: Mudanças hormonais dessa fase podem afetar a lágrima; saiba reconhecer os sinais e por que vale levar o incômodo ao oftalmologista
articles.summary: Mudanças hormonais dessa fase podem afetar a lágrima; saiba reconhecer os sinais e por que vale levar o incômodo ao oftalmologista
articles.body:
Sensação de areia é um dos sintomas do olho seco, que pode acometer 6 em cada 10 mulheres na menopausa — Foto: Divulgação

O dia começa cedo, as telas acompanham as horas de trabalho e, quando a noite chega, os olhos pedem trégua. É comum associar o cansaço ocular ao uso prolongado do celular ou à idade, deixando esse sinal de lado e seguindo com a rotina, até que a irritação volta no dia seguinte.

Muitas mulheres podem conviver com esses sinais sem saber que eles podem estar relacionados ao olho seco, condição que pode ser ignorada ou confundida com uma consequência natural do envelhecimento. Na menopausa, esses sintomas merecem atenção: seis em cada dez mulheres sofrem com olho seco nessa fase da vida, segundo publicação da Optometrists Network1.

O que os hormônios têm a ver com a lágrima

A resposta está na relação entre os hormônios sexuais e o funcionamento das estruturas que mantêm os olhos hidratados. Durante a perimenopausa e a menopausa, os níveis de androgênios e estrogênios passam por mudanças que podem interferir nesse processo.

Os androgênios, por exemplo, ajudam a regular a produção da parte aquosa da lágrima e de uma camada de gordura que impede sua evaporação rápida. Quando a ação desses hormônios se altera, a lágrima pode perder parte de sua capacidade de lubrificar e proteger os olhos. Os estrogênios também participam desse equilíbrio, embora sua influência sobre o olho seco ainda não seja totalmente compreendida.

Os sintomas costumam aparecer em momentos comuns do dia: diante do computador, no trânsito, na leitura antes de dormir. Entre os mais frequentes estão irritação, ressecamento ocular, ardência ou queimação e olhos cansados. Também podem surgir a sensação de areia ou de corpo estranho nos olhos e a sensibilidade à luz, conhecida como fotofobia.

Para quem já tem uma agenda cheia, é fácil tratar esses sinais como parte da correria. Mas, quando os sintomas se tornam frequentes, vale observar o momento que surgem, quanto tempo duram e o que pode intensificá-los. Essas informações são de extrema importância para compartilhar com um oftalmologista.

Reconhecer os sintomas é o primeiro passo, o segundo é procurar ajuda. O diagnóstico adequado é importante para entender as causas dos sintomas e orientar o cuidado mais apropriado para cada caso. No consultório, o médico pode recorrer a exames específicos, como os de avaliação do filme lacrimal.

Também vale lembrar que nem todo colírio é igual, por isso, a orientação de um especialista é tão importante. Foi com esse objetivo que a Alcon, líder mundial em oftalmologia, criou a iniciativa "Aliados pelo Alívio do Olho Seco". A ação quer ajudar mais pessoas a reconhecer seus sintomas, incentivando a consulta ao médico oftalmologista.

articles.title: Entrega da BR-447 é adiada para 2027 por atrasos na desapropriação  | G1
articles.standfirst: Desapropriação deve terminar em dezembro de 2026. Segundo o Departamento Nacional de Infraestrutura e Transportes (Dnit), a nova data para finalização da rodovia federal é junho de 2027.
articles.summary: Desapropriação deve terminar em dezembro de 2026. Segundo o Dnit, a nova data para finalização da rodovia federal é junho de 2027.
articles.body:
A entrega do novo trecho da BR-447 no Espírito Santo, que vai ligar a BR-262, em Viana, ao Porto de Capuaba, em Vila Velha, prometida para dezembro deste ano, foi adiada mais uma vez devido ao atraso no processo de desapropriação de terrenos no local.

Segundo o Departamento Nacional de Infraestrutura e Transportes (Dnit), a nova data para finalização da rodovia federal é junho de 2027.

As últimas famílias que ainda possuem imóveis e terrenos no trecho por onde a via vai passar ainda estão sendo indenizadas.

A previsão é de que essa etapa seja concluída até o fim de dezembro, permitindo o avanço das obras. O investimento total é de R$ 236 milhões, com recursos da União.

Início do novo trecho da BR-447, que vai ligar a BR-101 até a Rodovia Leste-Oeste — Foto: Fernando Madeira/Rede Gazeta

Com 4,3 quilômetros de extensão, esse trecho da BR será um dos menores de rodovia federal de todo o país , prometendo ligar a BR-101, nos limites entre Cariacica e Viana, próximo à antiga Braspérola, até a Rodovia estadual Leste-Oeste, ainda em Cariacica, perto do novo Hospital Geral.

Depois de pronto, o novo trecho da rodovia vai complementar outro já existente da BR-447, em Vila Velha. Com isso, segundo a Dnit, a rodovia passará a ter, ao todo, 16,3km de extensão.

Esse não é o primeiro adiamento da obra: em janeiro de 2024, o então ministro dos Transportes, Renan Filho, listou a via no Espírito Santo entre os 60 projetos previstos para serem entregues ou iniciados naquele ano.

Em 2023, a entrega da rodovia também foi anunciada, mas o governo federal só havia liberado 1,2 quilômetro de vias laterais até julho daquele ano, no trecho que liga os bairros São Francisco e Vila Betânia, nos municípios de Cariacica e Viana, respectivamente.

A ordem de serviço para a BR-447 foi assinada em 2019, com previsão inicial de até três anos para ser finalizada. Mas, em 2022, o governo federal explicou o desafio que enfrentava com as desapropriações dos mais de 300 imóveis no local.

Em setembro de 2026, o ministro dos Transportes, George Santoro, informou que o governo federal ainda aguardava a saída de sete famílias de áreas de risco antes de prosseguir com a obra. A promessa feita naquele mês era da conclusão da BR-447 em dezembro.

* Este conteúdo foi produzido por Emanoele Gobbi, residente do 29º Curso de Residência em Jornalismo da Rede Gazeta, sob orientação do editor Vitor Ferri.

articles.title: Short circuit triggers fire at Solapur textile factory, owner files Rs 87.33L claim, United India rejects it citing unauthorised construction; consumer commission orders insurer to pay Rs 87.33L after finding it had inspected premises before issuing policies
articles.summary: MUMBAI: Abhishek Dhanresha was the proprietor of Mateshri Textiles which manufactured towels and napkins at Solapur.
articles.body: MUMBAI: Abhishek Dhanresha was the proprietor of Mateshri Textiles which manufactured towels and napkins at Solapur.The unit was insured by United India Insurance under three policies - one for the factory building, the second for plant and machinery, and the third for the stock of finished and semi-finished goods, and raw materials.The total coverage under all the three policies amounted to Rs.91,50,000/. Prior to issuing the policies, the insurer had conducted a thorough inspection of the factory premises along with photographic documentation.On July 21, 2017 an electrical short circuit caused an accidental fire in the factory premises. This was immediately communicated to the police, fire department, electrical inspector, and the insurer. Later, a comprehensive claim for Rs.87,33,324/ was lodged.The insurer appointed a surveyor to assess the loss. Over a year later, the insurer sent a letter dated July 16, 2018 intimating that the claim was repudiated on the ground that there was illegal construction and unauthorized electric connection on the ground and second floors.Besides, the absence of fire extinguishing appliances was construed as negligence and a breach of the terms of the policy. The insured filed a complaint before the Maharashtra State Commission challenging the repudiation.The State Commission observed that the crux of the dispute was the unauthorized construction, unauthorized electricity connection, and absence of fire-fighting appliances.However, it noted that the insurer had had inspected the premises and then issued the policy with open eyes without raising any objection in respect of the alleged lapses and breaches.Hence the Commission concluded that the insurer could not be allowed to subsequently raise objections to avoid settlement of the claim and defeat the objective of taking insurance coverage.You Can Also Check: Gold Rate in Mumbai | Silver Rate in Mumbai | Bank Holidays in Mumbai | Public Holidays in Mumbai | Mumbai AQI | Weather in Mumbai | Petrol Price in Mumbai | Diesel Price in Mumbai | CNG Price in Mumbai | LPG Price in MumbaiStay updated with the latest Mumbai news. articles.title: Bengaluru woman deposits Rs 4L in FD with cooperative society, gets back Rs 3L after maturity but is made to wait for remaining amount, consumer commission orders society to pay Rs 1.12L with 12% interest and Rs 30k compensation
articles.summary: BENGALURU: The Bengaluru Urban District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission has directed Sree Thyagarajanagara Credit Co-operative Society to refund Rs
articles.body: BENGALURU: The Bengaluru Urban District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission has directed Sree Thyagarajanagara Credit Co-operative Society to refund Rs 1,12,304 to a woman towards her outstanding fixed deposit amount, along with 12% annual interest from February 4, 2023, until realisation.The commission also ordered the society to pay Rs 20,000 as compensation for deficiency in service and Rs 10,000 towards litigation expenses. It has been given 45 days to comply with the order.The complaint was filed by K P Vanajakshi, a resident of Banashankari II Stage, who had deposited a total of Rs 4 lakh in five fixed deposit accounts with the cooperative society.According to the complaint, Vanajakshi became a member of the society on November 19, 2016, and purchased 50 shares of Rs 100 each. Her husband was also a member of the society.She had deposited Rs 50,000 each in two fixed deposit accounts and Rs 1 lakh each in three other accounts, taking the total investment to Rs 4 lakh.After the deposits matured, the society transferred the amounts to her savings bank account instead of directly paying her. Despite repeated requests for repayment along with the agreed interest, the society paid only Rs 1 lakh on February 4, 2023, and another Rs 2 lakh on April 3, 2024.The remaining amount was not paid. Vanajakshi's husband also made several representations to the society and approached the Deputy Registrar of Cooperative Societies in Bengaluru on September 30, 2024.The complainant subsequently sent another representation through registered post on May 28, 2025, seeking withdrawal of the outstanding amount, but the society failed to comply.In its defence, the society admitted that Vanajakshi had deposited Rs 4 lakh in five fixed deposit accounts and that it had repaid Rs 3 lakh. It also acknowledged that Rs 1,12,304, including the applicable interest, remained payable.However, the society cited a financial crisis and shortage of funds, claiming that several members who had borrowed money from it had defaulted on loan repayments. It said the defaults had affected its financial stability and left it unable to return the remaining deposit amount.The society also argued that the complainant had earlier approached the Deputy Registrar of Cooperative Societies over the same issue.After examining the documents and submissions, the commission observed that the society had admitted both the fixed deposits and its liability to repay the outstanding amount. It noted that the society had accepted the deposits and was obligated to honour the terms and conditions after their maturity.The commission held that the society's failure to repay the entire matured deposit amount, despite making partial payments and acknowledging the outstanding liability, amounted to deficiency in service.It observed that the society could not escape its responsibility to return the depositor's money by citing its own financial difficulties arising from loan defaults by other members.Allowing the complaint in part, the commission directed the society to pay Rs 1,12,304 with 12% annual interest from February 4, 2023, until realisation, along with Rs 20,000 compensation and Rs 10,000 litigation costs.The order was passed on October 17, 2026, by commission president Ramachandra M S and members Nandini H Kumbhar and Savitha Airani.You Can Also Check: Gold Rate in Bengaluru | Silver Rate in Bengaluru | Bank Holidays in Bengaluru | Public Holidays in Bengaluru | Bengaluru AQI | Weather in Bengaluru | Petrol Price in Bengaluru | Diesel Price in Bengaluru | CNG Price in Bengaluru | LPG Price in BengaluruStay updated with the latest Bengaluru news. articles.title: Pakistan ship manoeuvred unsafely, suffered more damage: Navy chief on collision with INS Kolkata
articles.summary: NEW DELHI: Chief of Naval Staff Admiral Krishna Swaminathan on Monday spoke on the collision that took place between a Pakistani Navy vessel and an Indian
articles.body: NEW DELHI: Chief of Naval Staff Admiral Krishna Swaminathan on Monday spoke on the collision that took place between a Pakistani Navy vessel and an Indian warship in September. He stated that the Pakistani vessel suffered significantly more damage than the Indian warship.Speaking at the ANI National Security Summit 3.0 in New Delhi, Swaminathan said the collision involved Indian Navy's INS Kolkata and Pakistan Navy's PNS Hunain. He attributed the incident to unsafe manoeuvring by the Pakistani vessel, saying it had come so close that it reached a “point of no return”.“It's not unusual for ships to come close to each other at sea, and of course you manoeuvre in a little bit of competition, not so friendly. That ship was manoeuvring and I suppose it came dangerously close,” he said.The Navy chief said the Pakistani vessel appeared to have tried to move away at the last moment but ended up striking the Indian ship.“When two ships are closing each other, the ship tried to manoeuvre away from our ship, I suppose, but it touched our ship. Luckily, it touched our ship in a position where we had no damage, but that ship had a lot more damage,” he said.Swaminathan said the Indian vessel was not significantly affected by the impact, while the Pakistani ship sustained greater damage and subsequently returned to its port. He declined to comment on reports that PNS Hunain was still undergoing repairs more than two months after the collision.What happened during the September collisionThe incident took place on the evening of September 15, when PNS Hunain approached an Indian Navy frontline warship operating in the North Arabian Sea. Sources had earlier told TOI that the Pakistani vessel was moving at high speed and manoeuvring in an unsafe manner when the collision occurred.The Indian warship was on a routine surveillance mission, according to the earlier account. Sources had said that PNS Hunain returned to harbour after suffering severe damage, while the Indian vessel reported no damage.The ministry of external affairs had summoned Pakistan's charge d'affaires and lodged a strong protest over what it described as the “unacceptable and unprofessional conduct” of Pakistani naval units.New Delhi had also said the incident violated Article 10 of the April 1991 bilateral agreement on advance notice of military exercises. The provision requires naval vessels of the two countries to maintain a minimum distance of three nautical miles, according to the Indian government's position.The MEA had asked the Pakistani diplomat to convey to the authorities concerned the need for military units to exercise due care and comply with bilateral agreements to prevent a recurrence.Navy chief on US sinking of Iranian warshipSwaminathan also addressed the sinking of an Iranian warship by a US submarine in March, days after the Iranian vessel had participated in India's International Fleet Review in Visakhapatnam in February 2026.Describing the episode as an awkward situation for India, he said the fleet review was intended to promote friendship, cooperation and solidarity among participating countries. The Iranian vessel was returning home when it was attacked amid the US-Iran conflict.However, he said the US submarine's action was not illegal under international maritime law, as the two countries were already at war and the Iranian vessel was in international waters, outside India's territorial jurisdiction.“Because there are two belligerents. They had already gotten into a conflict. There are two nations at war,” he said, adding that military engagements during wartime could take place across different oceans.Swaminathan cited the Second World War, when fighting took place in the Atlantic and Pacific oceans, to explain that belligerents could engage their adversaries beyond the immediate theatre of conflict.He, however, declined to judge whether the US action was appropriate, saying that was a matter for the US Navy to address.The Navy chief also clarified that India's engagement with the Iranian vessel had ended after the fleet review. The ship was on its return journey and was no longer participating in the Indian exercise when it was attacked.Earlier India-Pakistan naval collisionThe September incident was not the first collision involving Indian and Pakistani naval vessels. In June 2011, Pakistan Navy ship PNS Babur brushed past Indian frigate INS Godavari in the Gulf of Aden, triggering a diplomatic row.PNS Babur was escorting the merchant vessel MV Suez, which had been released after being held by Somali pirates for several months. The incident damaged the helicopter net on INS Godavari after the Pakistani vessel approached it from behind.

articles.title: Bethlehem priest says US denied visa over Palestinian identity, cites Trump restrictions
articles.summary: A Greek Orthodox priest from Bethlehem has said the US denied him an entry visa because of his Palestinian identity, raising concerns over restrictions
articles.body: A Greek Orthodox priest from Bethlehem has said the US denied him an entry visa because of his Palestinian identity, raising concerns over restrictions affecting Palestinian Christians seeking to travel abroad.Father Issa Thaljieh, the Greek Orthodox parish priest at the Church of the Nativity in Bethlehem, was due to attend the "Not in Christ's Name" conference in Potomac, Maryland, on November 14.He was also expected to participate in an interfaith protest against Israeli settler violence near the US Capitol on November 16, The Jerusalem Post reported.Thaljieh said he had hoped to speak about the difficulties facing Palestinian Christians and share Bethlehem's message of peace and love ahead of Christmas.He applied for a visa despite restrictions imposed by US President Donald Trump, hoping to receive an exception.However, his application was rejected.In a statement, Thaljieh said his experience during the visa interview led him to believe that his Palestinian nationality was the main reason behind the decision."Throughout the interview, considerable emphasis was placed on the fact that I am Palestinian, and I felt that this was the main factor behind the decision to deny my visa," he said.He added that he had wanted to explain the challenges facing the Christian community in Bethlehem and the wider Palestinian population.Despite being unable to travel, Thaljieh participated in the event remotely through Zoom.US visa restrictions on PalestiniansThe visa denial comes amid broader restrictions introduced by the Trump administration on Palestinian Authority passport holders.Under Presidential Proclamation 10998, which came into effect on January 1, 2026, the US suspended the issuance of immigrant and non-immigrant visas to people travelling on documents issued or endorsed by the Palestinian Authority.The restrictions cover temporary visits as well as immigration, with limited exceptions, including case-by-case waivers when travel is considered to be in the US national interest. However, there is no specific exemption for religious leaders or clergy.It remains unclear whether Thaljieh's application was rejected under the broader restrictions or following an individual security assessment. The State Department has not disclosed the specific grounds for the refusal.A State Department spokesperson told The Jerusalem Post that the administration was enforcing US immigration laws and ensuring that all visa applicants met the requirements."Every visa decision is a national security decision," the spokesperson said.Palestinian Christians leaving BethlehemThaljieh has also warned that an increasing number of Palestinian Christians are leaving the Holy Land because of difficult political and economic conditions.He pointed to land seizures, attacks by Israeli settlers and deteriorating economic circumstances as factors putting pressure on Christian communities in the occupied West Bank."There are land seizures, occupier violence and attacks against Christians living in this Holy Land," he said, citing the predominantly Christian town of Taybeh as an example.He said the Christian population was steadily declining as more people emigrated because of the occupation, political instability and economic difficulties.Restrictions on movement and access to livelihoods have also affected Palestinian communities across the West Bank.Israeli permits and military checkpoints limit Palestinians' access to religious sites in occupied East Jerusalem, including the Church of the Holy Sepulchre, and their participation in religious observances.You use AI every day. articles.title: Warren Buffett donates $5.47 billion in Berkshire Hathaway shares to four charities run by his children, converts 6,150 Class A shares into 9.2 million Class B shares, backs successor Greg Abel's leadership
articles.summary: Warren Buffett, one of the world's most celebrated investors, has donated approximately $5.47 billion (around Rs 45,000 crore) worth of Berkshire Hathaway
articles.body: Warren Buffett, one of the world's most celebrated investors, has donated approximately $5.47 billion (around Rs 45,000 crore) worth of Berkshire Hathaway shares to four charitable foundations associated with his three children. The 96-year-old billionaire announced the donation in his annual Thanksgiving message, reiterating his commitment to philanthropy and expressing unwavering confidence in the leadership of the conglomerate he built over six decades.The latest donation comprises 9,225,000 Class B shares of Berkshire Hathaway, which Buffett obtained after converting 6,150 Class A shares. The shares have been distributed among four foundations: The Susan Thompson Buffett Foundation, The Sherwood Foundation, The Howard G. Buffett Foundation and the NoVo Foundation.According to the announcement, The Susan Thompson Buffett Foundation received 3,690,000 shares, while the other three foundations received 1,845,000 shares each. These foundations are associated with Buffett's children, Susie, Howard and Peter Buffett.With this latest contribution, Buffett has donated more than $29 billion worth of Berkshire Hathaway stock to the four foundations over the years. Despite the substantial giveaway, he continues to hold approximately 13% of Berkshire Hathaway's stock. Following the conversion and donation, Buffett retains 182,140 Class A shares, valued at approximately $162 billion.Buffett has reiterated that his entire Berkshire Hathaway stake will eventually go to the four foundations. His larger objective is to ensure that the charitable grants distributed by these organisations continue to grow every year.'Kindness is costless but also priceless': Buffett shares Thanksgiving messageAlongside the announcement, Buffett shared a Thanksgiving message reflecting on kindness, generosity and the importance of giving back. Referring to his previous year's message, he wrote, "Last Thanksgiving I wrote that kindness is costless but also priceless. A year later, I would only add that it compounds, and at a better rate than anything Charlie and I ever bought."The statement was a reminder of the values that shaped Buffett's professional and personal journey. He also acknowledged the contribution of influential mentors who helped him and his late business partner Charlie Munger achieve success.Referring to the benefits they received from their teachers, including Ben Graham, Joe Rosenfield and Tom Murphy, Buffett said that both he and Munger had received invaluable guidance that helped them prosper and eventually pass on those benefits to others.Warren Buffett expresses confidence in Berkshire Hathaway's new leadershipThe donation also reflects Buffett's faith in his children and the next generation of leadership at Berkshire Hathaway. The billionaire made it clear that he trusts his children's ability to manage the foundations and ensure that the money reaches deserving causes."My children have given thoughtfully to worthy causes for decades, and I trust 100% both their abilities and their fidelity," he said.He also reiterated his confidence in Berkshire Hathaway's leadership, adding, "You heard plenty from me in September about my confidence in Berkshire. That confidence is as strong as ever."Greg Abel took over as Berkshire Hathaway's CEO at the end of 2025, succeeding Buffett, who stepped down from the position after leading the company for decades. Buffett subsequently moved into the role of chairman emeritus, while his eldest son, Howard Buffett, became chairman in September.Reacting to the Thanksgiving message, Abel praised Buffett's continued efforts to inspire people through his words and actions. "Warren continues to share his wisdom with us all during this holiday season. His example reflects the kindness he encourages in all of us," he said.Warren Buffett's message to people this ThanksgivingConcluding his message, Buffett encouraged people to acknowledge those who have made a meaningful difference in their lives and, in turn, extend the same generosity to others."This Thanksgiving, thank one of those selfless people in your own life. Better yet, be a benefactor for someone else," he wrote.You use AI every day. Now get your AI Quotient. Take the AIQ test.

articles.title: Trump met Hollywood actor Jon Voight at White House as US flight shutdown stranded thousands: Report
articles.summary: US President Donald Trump reportedly spent Friday evening meeting Hollywood actor Jon Voight at the White House to discuss reviving the American
articles.body: US President Donald Trump reportedly spent Friday evening meeting Hollywood actor Jon Voight at the White House to discuss reviving the American entertainment industry, even as a nationwide air travel shutdown left thousands of passengers stranded across the country.According to The Atlantic, Trump met Voight, 87, in the Oval Office as the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) grounded all departing flights in the mainland US on Friday afternoon. The shutdown marked the first nationwide halt to American air travel since the September 11, 2001, attacks.More than 10,000 flights were delayed, leaving tens of thousands of travellers stranded at airports. Officials initially struggled to explain the disruption and did not immediately rule out the possibility of a cyberattack by a foreign adversary.Trump did not address the public during the crisis, leaving Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy and Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin to brief reporters. Mullin attributed the disruption to ageing equipment and said there was no threat to public safety.Instead, Trump reportedly used the evening to discuss legislation aimed at bringing film and television production back to the US with Hollywood figures, including Voight, his special ambassador to Hollywood.Voight was at the White House to advocate for a proposed tax incentive that would offer qualifying productions a federal tax credit covering 20% of their US labour costs, potentially rising to 30% with additional bonuses. The proposal is aimed at encouraging studios to shift production back from overseas.Producer Steven Paul told Variety that Voight made an emotional appeal for the proposal during the meeting and was crying by the end of his speech.Trump subsequently posted on Truth Social in support of the federal tax incentive, ending his message with the slogan: “MAKE OUR ENTERTAINMENT INDUSTRY GREAT AGAIN!”The FAA disruption was later attributed to overloaded routers linked to maintenance work by contractor L3Harris. The company said it was supporting the FAA's investigation.Defending Trump's absence from the public briefing, Mullin said the president “puts leaders in place, and he allows them to lead”.However, the president's response drew criticism from former Republican congresswoman Marjorie Taylor Greene, who wrote on X that Trump “didn't even bother to address the nation” while Americans were left wondering whether the country was under attack.Greene also criticised the briefing by Duffy and Mullin, calling it a “shakedown” after the transportation secretary asked Congress for $50 billion to modernise the air traffic control system.You use AI every day. articles.summary: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi captained Bihar in one match before joining India A for the Rising Stars Asia Cup. His departure meant Suraj Kashyap took over and led t...
articles.body:
NEW DELHI: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's stint as Bihar captain in the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy (SMAT) 2026-27 lasted just one match, despite being named to lead the side for its opening two fixtures. The 15-year-old missed Bihar's second Group B match against Railways on Monday because he was scheduled to join the India A squad for the ACC Men's Rising Stars Asia Cup 2026 in Doha. Sooryavanshi's captaincy appointment was always intended to be a short-term arrangement. He was named Bihar captain for the first two matches against Saurashtra and Railways while regular skipper Sakibul Gani was unavailable. However, his national commitments meant he had to link up with India A ahead of the tournament, which begins on November 19. With Sooryavanshi away, Suraj Kashyap took over the leadership responsibilities for Bihar against Railways. The change did little to affect the team's performance as Bihar registered a four-wicket victory, completing their chase of 138 with 10 balls to spare.

From record-breaking captaincy to India A call-up

Sooryavanshi made history in Bihar's tournament opener against Saurashtra on Saturday, becoming the youngest captain in men's T20 cricket at 15 years and 232 days. He surpassed Croatia's Zach Vukusic, who had previously held the record after captaining his national side at 17 years and 311 days. His captaincy debut also produced a light-hearted moment at the toss. After winning it and opting to bat, Sooryavanshi was asked about Bihar's playing XI but appeared to forget the details. "I think, sir, bhool gaya lagta main (I think, sir, I have forgotten)," he said with a smile. The teenager had described the opportunity to lead his home state as a dream come true, having started his cricketing journey in Bihar. However, his first match as captain ended in defeat. He scored 18 off 12 balls before being caught and bowled by Chetan Sakariya, as Bihar managed 137/9. Saurashtra chased down the target to win the contest. Sooryavanshi's next assignment is with India A, who will be led by Tilak Varma in the Rising Stars Asia Cup. The squad also features senior India opener Abhishek Sharma, Rinku Singh, Harshit Rana and several other established domestic performers. India A are in Group B alongside Pakistan A, Nepal and the United Arab Emirates. They begin their campaign against Nepal on November 20, followed by the much-anticipated clash against Pakistan A on November 22.

Bihar showed they could manage without their record-breaking young captain, beating Railways by four wickets in Indore. After being put in to bat, Railways were restricted to 137/9 in 20 overs. Jayant Lakhan top-scored with 47, while Zubair Ali Khan contributed 26. Prashant Singh led the bowling effort with 3/28, while Kashyap also picked up three wickets for 29 runs. Mohammed Izhar claimed two. In reply, Ayush Loharuka provided Bihar with a flying start, smashing 58 off just 29 balls, including five fours and five sixes. His dismissal at 78/2 in 8.2 overs briefly slowed the chase, but contributions from Tarun Kumar (20), Raghuvendra Pratap Singh (18) and Altamish Ashraf (15) kept Bihar on course. Kashyap remained unbeaten on 13 as Bihar reached 141/6 in 18.2 overs. His all-round contribution earned him the Player of the Match award.

articles.summary: Former NBA player Baron Davis is asking a California court to dismiss a lawsuit filed by his sister, Lissa Davis, who claims he sold a house he had
articles.body: Former NBA player Baron Davis is asking a California court to dismiss a lawsuit filed by his sister, Lissa Davis, who claims he sold a house he had promised would be hers after she spent her savings renovating it. The dispute centres on a Northridge property that Lissa says she believed was hers, despite the title remaining in her brother's name for tax reasons. In a November 14 report, TMZ revealed that Davis is challenging the legal basis of her claims, arguing that an alleged verbal promise cannot establish ownership of the property.Baron Davis' sister says she believed the house was hersAccording to TMZ, Lissa alleged that her brother helped her purchase a home nearly 20 years ago, following a difficult period in her personal life. She claimed she had experienced a life-threatening health problem after the birth of her son in 2008 and approached Baron for financial assistance.Lissa alleged that Baron persuaded her to sell her existing Northridge property, offering to arrange the purchase of another house through real estate agents he knew. The proposed arrangement, according to her lawsuit, was intended to provide her with a new place to live.She claimed her brother asked to keep the title of the replacement property in his name for tax purposes. Lissa allegedly accepted this arrangement on the understanding that the house was effectively hers, even though the legal ownership remained with Baron.Renovation costs became central to the disputeTMZ stated that Lissa subsequently found another property in Northridge and moved into it with her husband. According to her complaint, the couple invested their savings into renovating the house, believing they were improving a home that had been promised to them.The dispute reportedly remained unresolved for years, with Lissa continuing to live in the property. She alleges that the understanding between the siblings meant she would have a permanent home, despite her brother retaining legal ownership.The arrangement came under scrutiny earlier this year when Lissa allegedly discovered that the property was being put up for sale. She claims the news came from a third-party real estate agent rather than Baron himself.Lissa alleged her brother had not informed her about the sale or discussed his plans with her. Her lawsuit accused him of fraud and intentional infliction of emotional distress, among other claims, and sought an unspecified amount in damages.Baron Davis challenges the alleged agreementBaron's legal team is seeking to have the complaint dismissed. His lawyers argue that Lissa cannot establish ownership of the property through an alleged verbal promise. The defence maintains that California law requires agreements involving real estate interests to be made in writing.The argument directly challenges the foundation of Lissa's complaint, which relies on her understanding that the property was intended to be hers despite the title remaining in her brother's name.Baron is also disputing the suggestion that their family relationship created a special legal obligation to disclose information about the property. His lawyers argue that being siblings, by itself, does not establish a legal duty to share details about a transaction or property decision.TMZ reported that the defence described a family relationship based on trust as insufficient, without additional circumstances, to create a legal obligation to disclose information.Rent-free living forms part of Baron's defenceAnother significant part of Baron's response concerns the length of time Lissa lived in the house.According to TMZ's November report, he argues that his sister occupied the property without paying rent for nearly two decades. His legal team maintains that this arrangement does not automatically give her ownership rights or establish that the alleged promise was legally enforceable.The defence is seeking to separate Lissa's long-term occupation of the property from the question of who legally owned it.His lawyers are asking the court to dismiss the lawsuit without allowing Lissa an opportunity to amend her complaint.
